01_repository_summary.title: Repository Summary
01_repository_summary.what_repository_does: Metalist is a service to store a set of configurations for a player to pull during playback. This is one of the services powering the overall system of live actions. Creates a timeline event in the database. Each request is additive and should contain a single moment. Update/overwrite previously published events. Gets the timeline events from the database for a specific pvid. Deletes a timeline event from the database. Gets health-check status. Returns 200 if all status checks are OK. Gets application metrics data. To be used for reporting prometheus metrics. Personalized Ad Service API uses Swag for documentation generation. To update API docs: 1. Add comments to your API handler in the Declarative Comments Format. 3. Run the following command in the project's root directory to generate the latest documentation: Remember to push the latest documentation generated under swagger directory to GitHub. 4. Once the app is started, Swagger UI is available at http://localhost:8081/swagger/index.html -   checkgofmt.sh a script run by pipeline-test.yaml that will fail if go source files aren't gofmt formatted
